exercises.benchPressDesc: Flat bench with barbell. Primarily chest, secondarily triceps and front delts.
exercises.inclineBenchPressDesc: Incline bench (30-45 degrees) with barbell. Emphasizes upper chest.
exercises.dumbbellFlyesDesc: Fly movement with dumbbells on flat bench. Stretches and isolates the chest.
exercises.cableCrossoverDesc: Cable from high to low crossover. Good chest isolation.
exercises.chestDipsDesc: Dips with forward lean. Trains chest and triceps with bodyweight.
exercises.chestPressMachineDesc: Guided chest press machine. Ideal for beginners.
exercises.declineBenchPressDesc: Bench press on a decline bench with barbell. Emphasizes the lower chest and triceps.
exercises.inclineDumbbellPressDesc: Dumbbell press on an incline bench (30-45 degrees). Targets the upper chest with greater range of motion than barbell.
exercises.flatDumbbellPressDesc: Dumbbell press on a flat bench. Allows greater range of motion and balances strength imbalances.
exercises.declineDumbbellPressDesc: Dumbbell press on a decline bench. Targets the lower chest with free weights.
exercises.inclineDumbbellFlyesDesc: Fly movement with dumbbells on an incline bench. Stretches and isolates the upper chest.
exercises.cableFlyesLowDesc: Cable flyes from the low position upward. Emphasizes the upper chest and inner chest line.
exercises.cableFlyesHighDesc: Cable flyes from the high position downward. Emphasizes the lower chest with constant tension.
exercises.pecDeckDesc: Chest fly machine with guided movement. Isolates the chest and is ideal for controlled repetitions.
exercises.smithMachineBenchDesc: Bench press on the Smith machine. Guided movement for safe training without a spotter.
exercises.smithMachineInclineDesc: Incline press on the Smith machine. Guided movement focusing on the upper chest.
exercises.landminePressDesc: Pressing a barbell anchored in a corner. Trains chest, shoulders, and core at a unique angle.
exercises.pushUpWideDesc: Push-ups with wide hand placement. Emphasizes the outer chest more than standard push-ups.
exercises.pushUpDiamondDesc: Push-ups with hands close together in a diamond shape. Strong focus on triceps and inner chest.
exercises.pushUpDeclineDesc: Push-ups with elevated feet. Shifts weight toward the upper chest and shoulders.
exercises.pushUpInclineDesc: Push-ups with hands elevated on a bench. Easier variation, ideal for beginners.
exercises.svendPressDesc: Squeeze a plate or dumbbells together in front of the chest and press forward. Strong chest activation through isometric tension.
exercises.chestSqueezePressDesc: Press dumbbells firmly together while pressing. Maximum chest contraction through constant inward pressure.
exercises.singleArmCablePressDesc: Single-arm pressing on the cable machine. Trains the chest unilaterally and improves muscular balance.
exercises.aroundTheWorldDesc: Move dumbbells in a wide arc from hips over the head and back. Stretches and trains the entire chest.
exercises.platePressDesc: Squeeze a weight plate with both hands in front of the chest and press forward. Effective chest activation without heavy weights.
exercises.guillotinePressDesc: Bench press with the bar lowered to the neck instead of the chest. Greater chest stretch, requires lighter weight and strict form.
exercises.hexPressDesc: Press dumbbells together in neutral grip on a flat bench. Strong activation of the inner chest.
exercises.machineChestFlyDesc: Fly movement on a machine. Guided chest isolation with constant tension throughout the movement.
exercises.resistanceBandChestPressDesc: Chest press with resistance band. Ideal for warm-ups, rehabilitation, or training on the go.
exercises.deadliftDesc: Compound barbell exercise from the floor. Trains entire back and legs.
exercises.pullUpsDesc: Bodyweight exercise on the bar. Primarily lats and biceps.
exercises.barbellRowDesc: Bent-over row with barbell. Trains the upper back.
exercises.latPulldownDesc: Cable pulldown to chest. Alternative to pull-ups.
exercises.seatedCableRowDesc: Seated rowing on cable machine. Trains the mid back.
exercises.dumbbellRowDesc: Single-arm row with dumbbell. Good lat isolation.
exercises.tBarRowDesc: Rowing on a T-bar machine or landmine attachment. Trains the mid and upper back with heavy weight.
exercises.pendlayRowDesc: Explosive barbell row from the floor with full reset between reps. Builds back strength and explosiveness.
exercises.meadowsRowDesc: Single-arm landmine row in a staggered stance. Great range of motion for the lats and upper back.
exercises.chestSupportedRowDesc: Dumbbell row with chest supported on an incline bench. Isolates the back without lower back strain.
exercises.singleArmCableRowDesc: Single-arm rowing on the cable machine. Allows targeted unilateral back work with constant tension.
exercises.wideGripPulldownDesc: Lat pulldown with a wide overhand grip. Emphasizes the outer lats for a wide V-taper.
exercises.closeGripPulldownDesc: Lat pulldown with a close grip. Greater focus on the lower lats and biceps.
exercises.reverseGripPulldownDesc: Lat pulldown with underhand grip (palms facing you). Emphasizes lower lats and activates biceps more.
exercises.straightArmPulldownDesc: Pulldown with straight arms on the cable machine. Isolates the lats without bicep involvement.
exercises.cablePulloverDesc: Pullover movement on the cable machine. Trains lats and chest with constant cable tension.
exercises.machineRowDesc: Rowing on a guided machine. Safe back training with controlled movement.
exercises.smithMachineRowDesc: Bent-over row on the Smith machine. Guided movement for controlled back training.
exercises.rackPullDesc: Deadlift from an elevated position in the power rack. Focuses on upper back and traps with heavier weight.
exercises.goodMorningDesc: Forward bend with barbell on shoulders. Trains the lower back, posterior chain, and hamstrings.
exercises.hyperextensionDesc: Back extension on a 45-degree bench. Strengthens the lower back and posterior chain.
exercises.reverseHyperextensionDesc: Reverse back extension with leg raise. Trains glutes, hamstrings, and lower back in a joint-friendly way.
exercises.chinUpsDesc: Pull-ups with underhand grip. Greater bicep involvement than regular pull-ups, trains lats and arms.
exercises.invertedRowDesc: Horizontal bodyweight row under a low bar. Great entry-level exercise for building up to pull-ups.
exercises.sealRowDesc: Lying face down on an elevated bench with dumbbell rows. Eliminates momentum and fully isolates the back.
exercises.krocRowDesc: Heavy single-arm dumbbell row with controlled momentum and high reps. Builds grip strength and upper back.
exercises.helmsRowDesc: Chest-supported dumbbell row on an incline bench with neutral grip. Combines isolation with full range of motion.
exercises.snatchGripDeadliftDesc: Deadlift with an extra-wide grip. Increases range of motion and intensifies upper back and trap engagement.
exercises.deficitDeadliftDesc: Deadlift from an elevated platform. Increases range of motion and improves strength off the floor.
exercises.sumoDeadliftDesc: Deadlift with wide stance and narrow grip. Emphasizes legs and hips more, easier on the lower back.
exercises.highRowDesc: Rowing on the high row machine with an elevated pull point. Targets upper back, rear delts, and rhomboids.
exercises.mTorture2WayRowDesc: Specialized rowing machine with two movement angles. Trains the back through alternating pull directions for maximum muscle activation.
exercises.overheadPressDesc: Barbell pressed overhead. Primarily front and lateral delts.
exercises.lateralRaiseDesc: Dumbbells raised to the sides. Isolates the lateral deltoid.
exercises.facePullDesc: Cable pulled to face height. Trains rear delts and rotator cuff.
exercises.frontRaiseDesc: Dumbbells raised to the front. Isolates the front deltoid.
exercises.reverseFlyesDesc: Seated dumbbell reverse fly. Trains the rear deltoid.
exercises.arnoldPressDesc: Dumbbell press with rotation from in front of the chest to overhead. Trains all three deltoid heads in one fluid movement.
exercises.dumbbellLateralRaiseSeatedDesc: Seated dumbbell lateral raises. Eliminates momentum and better isolates the lateral deltoid.
exercises.cableLateralRaiseDesc: Lateral raise on the cable machine for constant tension throughout the range of motion. Isolates the lateral deltoid.
exercises.dumbbellFrontRaiseAlternatingDesc: Alternating dumbbell front raises. Trains the front deltoid with focus on each side individually.
exercises.barbellFrontRaiseDesc: Front raise with a barbell. Trains the front deltoid with both arms simultaneously.
exercises.cableFrontRaiseDesc: Front raise on the cable machine for constant tension. Effectively isolates the front deltoid.
exercises.rearDeltFlyMachineDesc: Reverse flyes on the machine. Guided movement for rear deltoid isolation.
exercises.rearDeltCableFlyDesc: Reverse flyes on the cable machine. Trains the rear deltoid with constant cable tension.
exercises.dumbbellShoulderPressSeatedDesc: Seated dumbbell shoulder press. Stable position for heavy shoulder training.
exercises.smithMachineShoulderPressDesc: Shoulder press on the Smith machine. Guided movement for safe shoulder training.
exercises.behindNeckPressDesc: Overhead press with the barbell behind the head. Targets the lateral and rear deltoids. Requires good shoulder mobility.
exercises.bradfordPressDesc: Alternating barbell press in front and behind the head without full lockout. Trains all deltoid heads with constant tension.
exercises.landmineLateralRaiseDesc: Lateral raise with an anchored barbell. Unique resistance angle for the lateral deltoid.
exercises.uprightRowDesc: Grip barbell narrowly and pull upward along the body. Trains shoulders and trapezius.
exercises.cableUprightRowDesc: Upright row on the cable machine for constant tension. Trains shoulders and trapezius more joint-friendly.
exercises.dumbbellShrugsDesc: Shoulder shrugs with dumbbells. Trains the trapezius with free range of motion.
exercises.barbellShrugsDesc: Shoulder shrugs with a barbell. Trains the trapezius with heavy weight.
exercises.luRaisesDesc: Raise dumbbells with slightly bent arms to the sides and front in a Y-shape. Trains front and lateral deltoids simultaneously.
exercises.plateFrontRaiseDesc: Front raise with a weight plate. Trains the front deltoid and grip strength.
exercises.bandPullApartDesc: Pull a resistance band apart in front of the chest. Trains the rear deltoids and improves posture.
exercises.machineLateralRaiseDesc: Lateral raise on a guided machine. Isolates the lateral deltoid without momentum.
exercises.dumbbellYRaiseDesc: Raise dumbbells in a Y-shape on an incline bench. Targets rear delts and upper back.
exercises.barbellCurlDesc: Curls with barbell. Fundamental bicep exercise.
exercises.dumbbellCurlDesc: Curls with dumbbells, alternating or simultaneous.
exercises.hammerCurlDesc: Curls with neutral grip. Trains biceps and brachialis.
exercises.preacherCurlDesc: Curls on preacher bench. Isolates biceps through fixed position.
exercises.inclineDumbbellCurlDesc: Dumbbell curls on an incline bench. Greater bicep stretch emphasizing the long head.
exercises.concentrationCurlDesc: Single-arm seated curls with elbow braced against the inner thigh. Maximum bicep isolation.
exercises.spiderCurlDesc: Curls lying face down on an incline bench. Eliminates momentum and isolates the bicep in the contracted position.
exercises.cableCurlDesc: Bicep curls on the cable machine. Constant tension throughout the entire range of motion.
exercises.cableHammerCurlDesc: Hammer curls on the cable machine with rope attachment. Trains biceps and brachialis with constant tension.
exercises.ezBarCurlDesc: Curls with the EZ curl bar. Easier on the wrists while effectively training the biceps.
exercises.reverseCurlDesc: Curls with an overhand grip. Trains the brachioradialis and forearms in addition to the biceps.
exercises.dragCurlDesc: Pull the barbell upward along the body with elbows driven back. Emphasizes the long head of the bicep.
exercises.bayesianCurlDesc: Single-arm cable curl from behind with extended shoulder. Maximum stretch of the long bicep head.
exercises.machineCurlDesc: Bicep curls on a machine. Guided movement for safe bicep isolation.
exercises.chinUpBicepsDesc: Chin-ups with underhand grip focusing on the biceps. Heavy compound exercise for biceps and back.
exercises.zottmanCurlDesc: Curl up with supination and lower with pronation. Trains biceps and forearms in one exercise.
exercises.crossBodyHammerCurlDesc: Hammer curls across the body toward the opposite shoulder. Emphasizes the brachialis and long bicep head.
exercises.waiterCurlDesc: Hold one dumbbell from underneath with both hands and curl. Strong activation of the short bicep head.
exercises.twentyOnesCurlDesc: 7 half curls bottom, 7 half curls top, 7 full curls. Intensity technique for maximum bicep exhaustion.
exercises.cablePreacherCurlDesc: Preacher curls on the cable machine. Constant tension throughout the range of motion for maximum bicep isolation.
exercises.scottCurlDumbbellDesc: Dumbbell curls on the Scott bench (preacher bench). Isolates the biceps with fixed upper arms, preventing momentum.
exercises.tricepPushdownDesc: Cable pushed downward. Fundamental tricep exercise.
exercises.skullCrushersDesc: Barbell lowered to forehead while lying. Intense tricep exercise.
exercises.overheadTricepExtensionDesc: Dumbbell extended behind head. Emphasizes long tricep head.
exercises.tricepDipsDesc: Dips with upright body. Focus on triceps.
exercises.closeGripBenchPressDesc: Bench press with a narrow grip. Shifts the load to the triceps and inner chest.
exercises.tricepKickbackDesc: Extend dumbbell backward while bent over. Isolates the tricep in the extension phase.
exercises.diamondPushUpTricepsDesc: Push-ups with hands close together. Strong focus on the triceps with bodyweight.
exercises.cableOverheadExtensionDesc: Overhead tricep extension on the cable machine. Emphasizes the long tricep head with constant tension.
exercises.singleArmPushdownDesc: Single-arm cable pushdown. Allows focused work on each tricep individually.
exercises.ropePushdownDesc: Tricep pushdown with rope attachment. Allows rotation at the bottom for stronger contraction.
exercises.vBarPushdownDesc: Tricep pushdown with V-bar attachment. Stable grip for heavy tricep training.
exercises.jmPressDesc: Hybrid of bench press and skull crushers. The barbell is lowered to chin level and pressed explosively.
exercises.frenchPressDesc: Overhead tricep extension with barbell, seated or standing. Strong stretch of the long tricep head.
exercises.dumbbellTricepPressDesc: Tricep extension with a dumbbell behind the head, single or double arm. Emphasizes the long tricep head.
exercises.benchDipsDesc: Dips between two benches with hands behind the body. Bodyweight tricep exercise.
exercises.machineTricepExtensionDesc: Tricep extension on a machine. Guided movement for safe tricep isolation.
exercises.tatePressDesc: Lower dumbbells to chest with elbows flared out on a flat bench, then extend. Intense tricep isolation.
exercises.bodyweightTricepExtensionDesc: Place hands on an elevated surface and lower body, then push up with triceps. Effective exercise without weights.
exercises.cableTricepKickbackDesc: Tricep kickbacks on the cable machine. Constant tension for better tricep isolation than dumbbells.
exercises.ezBarSkullCrusherDesc: Skull crushers with the EZ curl bar. Easier on the wrists while intensely training the triceps.
exercises.dipMachineDesc: Guided dips on the machine. Trains triceps and chest with adjustable weight, ideal for beginners.
exercises.squatDesc: Compound barbell exercise. Trains quads, glutes, and core.
exercises.legPressDesc: Guided leg press machine. Trains the entire leg musculature.
exercises.lungesDesc: Walking or stationary lunges with dumbbells. Trains legs and balance.
exercises.romanianDeadliftDesc: Deadlift with straight legs. Focus on posterior chain.
exercises.hackSquatDesc: Squats on the hack squat machine. Trains the quadriceps with guided movement and takes load off the back.
exercises.pendulumSquatDesc: Squats on the pendulum machine. Unique movement angle for maximum quadriceps activation.
exercises.bulgarianSplitSquatDesc: Single-leg squat with rear foot elevated on a bench. Trains legs, glutes, and balance.
exercises.gobletSquatDesc: Squat holding a dumbbell at chest height. Ideal for beginners and improving squat technique.
exercises.frontSquatDesc: Squat with the barbell in front of the shoulders. Greater quadriceps emphasis requiring an upright torso.
exercises.safetyBarSquatDesc: Squat with the safety squat bar. Easier on the shoulders and shifts the load slightly forward.
exercises.sissySquatDesc: Squat with knees pushing forward and upright torso. Intense quadriceps isolation.
exercises.pistolSquatDesc: Single-leg squat with the other leg extended forward. Requires strength, balance, and mobility.
exercises.smithMachineSquatDesc: Squats on the Smith machine. Guided movement for safe training without a spotter.
exercises.legPressNarrowDesc: Leg press with narrow foot placement. Greater emphasis on the outer quadriceps.
exercises.legPressWideDesc: Leg press with wide foot placement. Greater emphasis on the adductors and inner thigh.
exercises.walkingLungesDesc: Lunges while walking forward with dumbbells. Dynamically trains legs, glutes, and balance.
exercises.reverseLungesDesc: Backward lunges with dumbbells. More joint-friendly than forward lunges.
exercises.stepUpWeightedDesc: Step onto a platform with dumbbells. Trains quadriceps, glutes, and balance unilaterally.
exercises.hipAdductorDesc: Bring legs together on the machine. Trains the inner thigh muscles (adductors).
exercises.hipAbductorDesc: Push legs apart on the machine. Trains the outer hip muscles (abductors).
exercises.nordicHamstringCurlDesc: Eccentric hamstring exercise kneeling with fixed feet. Strengthens hamstrings and helps prevent injuries.
exercises.gluteHamRaiseDesc: Hip extension and knee flexion on the GHD machine. Trains glutes and hamstrings simultaneously.
exercises.stiffLegDeadliftDesc: Deadlift with nearly straight legs. Maximum stretch of the posterior chain and hamstrings.
exercises.beltSquatDesc: Squats with weight attached to a belt instead of on the shoulders. Trains the legs without spinal loading.
exercises.seatedLegCurlDesc: Leg curl machine in seated position. Isolates the hamstrings with controlled movement.
exercises.lyingLegCurlDesc: Leg curl machine in lying position. Trains the hamstrings through full range of motion.
exercises.singleLegPressDesc: Leg press with one leg. Corrects strength imbalances and trains stability.
exercises.hipThrustDesc: Hip extension with barbell on bench. Best exercise for glutes.
exercises.cableKickbackDesc: Leg kickback on cable machine. Isolates the glutes.
exercises.gluteBridgeDesc: Hip raise on the floor. Activates glutes with bodyweight.
exercises.barbellGluteBridgeDesc: Glute bridge with barbell across the hips. Progressive overload for maximum glute development.
exercises.sumoSquatDesc: Squats with extra wide stance and a dumbbell. Emphasizes glutes and inner thighs.
exercises.cablePullThroughDesc: Pull cable through legs from behind. Trains glutes and posterior chain with constant tension.
exercises.machineHipThrustDesc: Hip thrust on a dedicated machine. Easy setup with strong glute isolation.
exercises.donkeyKickDesc: On all fours, kick one leg back and up. Isolates the glutes with bodyweight.
exercises.crunchesDesc: Classic ab exercise. Trains the upper abs.
exercises.hangingLegRaiseDesc: Raise legs while hanging from bar. Trains lower abs.
exercises.cableCrunchDesc: Crunches on cable machine for progressive overload.
exercises.plankDesc: Static hold position. Trains the entire core.
exercises.russianTwistDesc: Seated, rotate the torso side to side with weight. Targets the obliques and rotational core strength.
exercises.abWheelRolloutDesc: Roll forward with an ab wheel and return. Intense core exercise targeting the entire abdominal wall.
exercises.bicycleCrunchDesc: Alternate bringing elbow to opposite knee. Trains rectus abdominis and obliques simultaneously.
exercises.legRaiseLyingDesc: Lying flat on back, raise straight legs up. Emphasizes the lower abdominals.
exercises.woodchopCableDesc: Diagonal pulling motion on the cable machine from high to low. Trains rotation and lateral core muscles.
exercises.deadBugDesc: Lying on back, extend opposite arm and leg. Strengthens the core and improves stability.
exercises.calfRaiseStandingDesc: Standing on calf raise machine. Trains the gastrocnemius.
exercises.calfRaiseSeatedDesc: Seated on calf raise machine. Trains the soleus.
exercises.smithMachineCalfRaiseDesc: Calf raises on the Smith machine with a platform under the feet. Allows heavy training with guided movement.
exercises.donkeyCalfRaiseDesc: Calf raises in a bent-over position with weight on the hips. Classic exercise for maximum calf stretch.
exercises.singleLegCalfRaiseDesc: Calf raise on one leg with bodyweight. Corrects strength imbalances and improves balance.
exercises.wristCurlDesc: Curl dumbbell with wrists. Trains forearm flexors.
exercises.reverseWristCurlDesc: Curl dumbbell with reverse grip. Trains forearm extensors.
exercises.farmersWalkDesc: Carry heavy dumbbells and walk. Trains grip strength, forearms, traps, and core stability.
exercises.platePinchDesc: Pinch weight plates together with fingertips and hold. Builds extreme grip strength and forearm power.
exercises.behindBackWristCurlDesc: Curl a barbell behind the back with the wrists. Trains forearm flexors through full range of motion.
exercises.runningDesc: Run outdoors or on a treadmill. Improves endurance and cardiovascular fitness.
exercises.cyclingDesc: Cycle outdoors or on a stationary bike. Low-impact endurance exercise.
exercises.ellipticalDesc: Full-body cardio on the elliptical machine. Easy on the joints.
exercises.rowingMachineDesc: Full-body cardio on the rowing machine. Trains back, arms, and legs simultaneously.
exercises.swimmingDesc: Swim in a pool or open water. Low-impact full-body workout.
exercises.jumpRopeDesc: Jump rope for endurance, coordination, and fat burning. Improves speed and footwork.
exercises.burpeesDesc: Full-body exercise: push-up, jump, repeat. Extremely effective for conditioning.
exercises.mountainClimbersDesc: In push-up position, alternate driving knees to chest. Cardio and core.
exercises.jumpSquatsDesc: Squats with explosive jump. Trains legs and jumping power.
exercises.highKneesDesc: Run in place with high knees. Quick heart rate boost.
exercises.boxJumpsDesc: Jump onto an elevated box. Trains explosive power and coordination.
exercises.battleRopesDesc: Swing heavy ropes in wave motions. Intense upper body cardio.
exercises.kettlebellSwingsDesc: Swing kettlebell between legs. Trains hips, back, and conditioning.
exercises.pushUpsDesc: Classic push-ups. Trains chest, shoulders, and triceps with bodyweight.
exercises.jumpingJacksDesc: Spread arms and legs simultaneously. Warm-up and cardio exercise.
exercises.wallSitDesc: Hold sitting position against a wall. Isometric leg exercise.
exercises.stepUpsDesc: Step onto and off a bench or step. Trains legs and balance.
exercises.bodyweightSquatsDesc: Squats without weight. Fundamental leg and glute exercise.
exercises.shadowBoxingDesc: Boxing combinations in the air without an opponent. Perfect for warmup and technique.
exercises.heavyBagRoundsDesc: Rounds on the heavy bag. Trains punching power, endurance, and combinations.
exercises.padWorkDesc: Combinations on pads with a partner. Trains precision and reaction time.
exercises.speedBagDesc: Training on the speed bag. Improves hand-eye coordination and rhythm.
exercises.slipAndRollDesc: Practice slipping and rolling head movements. Defensive boxing technique.
exercises.kickCombosDesc: Punch-kick combination drills. Foundation of kickboxing.
exercises.roundhouseKickDrillDesc: Repeated roundhouse kick practice. Trains technique and hip rotation.
exercises.thaiClinchDesc: Muay Thai style clinch work. Knee techniques and control.
exercises.lowKickDrillDesc: Repeated low kicks to thigh level. Fundamental kickboxing technique.
exercises.groundAndPoundDesc: Ground fighting with strikes from top position. Core MMA technique.
exercises.takedownDrillDesc: Repeated takedown practice. Single-leg, double-leg, and clinch throws.
exercises.sprawlDrillDesc: Takedown defense practice. Explosive leg sprawl movement.
exercises.cageWorkDesc: Cage/wall work for MMA. Applying pressure and controlling position.
exercises.uchikomiDrillDesc: Repeated entry into throwing techniques without completing the throw. Trains timing and coordination.
exercises.nagekomiDesc: Throwing technique training with a partner. Repeated throwing to perfect technique.
exercises.newazaDrillDesc: Judo ground techniques. Practicing pins, chokes, and joint locks.
exercises.randoriDesc: Free practice sparring in Judo. Applying all techniques with a partner.
exercises.guardPassingDesc: Drills for passing the guard position in BJJ. Technique and pressure building.
exercises.sweepDrillDesc: Sweep techniques from various guard positions. Reversing control.
exercises.submissionFlowDesc: Flowing through submission chains. Armbars, chokes, and leg locks.
exercises.bjjRollingDesc: Free rolling in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu. Ground sparring with rotating partners.
exercises.poomsaeDesc: Forms practice in Taekwondo. Fixed sequence of techniques for perfection.
exercises.turningKickDrillDesc: Repeated practice of the turning kick (Dollyo Chagi). Core Taekwondo technique.
exercises.sparringTkdDesc: Competition-style Taekwondo sparring with protective gear.
exercises.boardBreakingDesc: Breaking boards or tiles with strikes/kicks. Trains power, technique, and mental focus.
exercises.singleLegDrillDesc: Repeated single-leg takedown practice. Fundamental wrestling technique.
exercises.doubleLegDrillDesc: Double-leg takedown. Explosive shot and lift of the opponent.
exercises.wrestlingConditioningDesc: Wrestling-specific strength and endurance training. Bridges, sprawls, and crawls.
exercises.matReturnsDesc: Techniques for returning the opponent to the mat from standing position.
exercises.jumpLungesDesc: Explosive lunges switching legs mid-air. Trains legs and conditioning.
exercises.plankJacksDesc: In a forearm plank, jump feet apart and together like a jumping jack. Core and conditioning.
exercises.jabCrossDesc: The classic 1-2 combination: straight lead-hand jab followed by the rear-hand cross.
exercises.hooksDesc: Lateral punches with a bent arm. Power comes from hip rotation.
exercises.uppercutsDesc: Upward punches driven from the hips. Builds close-range punching power.
exercises.footworkDrillsDesc: Step patterns, direction changes and distance control. The foundation of every striking art.
exercises.frontKickDesc: Straight kick to the front with the ball of the foot. Range weapon and push kick.
exercises.kneeStrikesDesc: Explosive knee strikes from the clinch or at range. Trains hip power and balance.
exercises.elbowStrikesDesc: Short, hard elbow techniques at close range. Precision over power.
exercises.airBikeDesc: Fan bike with moving arm levers. Arms and legs work together — very demanding while easy on the joints.
exercises.stepmillDesc: A never-ending staircase. Very intense cardio for legs and glutes.
exercises.treadmillWalkDesc: Brisk walking, ideally on an incline. Joint-friendly and good for warm-ups or easy sessions.
exercises.hipHingeDesc: The base movement behind deadlifts and rows: push the hips back, keep the back flat. Learn it with a light dumbbell before adding load.

plans.pushPullLegsDesc: Split en 3 jours : poussée, tirage et jambes. Idéal pour les niveaux intermédiaire à confirmé.
plans.upperLowerDesc: Split en 2 jours : haut et bas du corps en alternance. Bien pour les débutants et intermédiaires.
plans.fiveDaySplitDesc: Chaque groupe musculaire a son jour. Pour les pratiquants confirmés.

plans.boxingBasicsDesc: 6 rounds de boxe classique. Shadow boxing, sac lourd, pattes d'ours et défense.
plans.kickboxingWorkoutDesc: 5 rounds de kickboxing avec combinaisons poing-pied, corps à corps et low kicks.
plans.mmaConditioningDesc: 5 rounds d'entraînement MMA. Takedowns, ground and pound, sprawls et travail en cage.
plans.karateTrainingDesc: 4 rounds de karaté. Kihon, kata, kumite et makiwara.
plans.martialArtsPlanName: Nom du programme de sports de combat
plans.couchTo5kDesc: Programme de course pour débutants. Du canapé à ton premier 5 km.
plans.cyclingEnduranceDesc: Vélo avec durée et distance croissantes pour développer l'endurance.
plans.tabataDesc: 8 rounds : 20 secondes à fond, 10 secondes de repos. Extrêmement efficace en 4 minutes.
plans.hiit3030Desc: 10 rounds : 30 secondes d'effort, 30 secondes de repos. Équilibré et intense.
plans.fullBodyCircuitDesc: 3 tours de 6 exercices. 40 secondes d'effort, 20 secondes de repos.
plans.coreCircuitDesc: 4 tours de 4 exercices. 30 secondes d'effort, 15 secondes de repos. Focus sur le tronc.
